extra_params.video_script: The boxer who inspired Rocky actually lost to Muhammad Ali. And round nine of that fight still starts arguments. His name was Chuck Wepner, a New Jersey club fighter nicknamed the Bayonne Bleeder. He once said he needed 328 stitches over his career. In 1975, he got a shot at Ali's heavyweight title. Bookmakers made him a massive underdog. Ali's purse was more than ten times bigger than his. Then, in the ninth round, the champion ended up on the canvas. Subscribe so you don't miss Part 2.
